snacs_adapt_rules.txt:
Useful SNACS adaptation rules from examples and guidelines:
1) to + destination/goal mention (go to a place, school, elsewhere) -> role/function often p.Goal; do not confuse with source or path.
2) of can be p.Whole when it links a partitive quantity expression to its whole (e.g., each of you).
3) of can be p.Topic when the complement is what a stimulus/mental-state predicate is about (e.g., proud of your contributions).
4) Possessive pronouns before nouns typically annotate as p.Possessor / p.Possessor.
5) by in phrases like start by saying is p.Means / p.Means (means of doing/speaking).
6) at + named venue/place and on + street/road are typically p.Locus / p.Locus.
7) throughout + time span is p.Duration / p.Duration.
